title: Bitcoin Slang Remix
description: Bitcoin Slang Remix rebuilds the earlier Bitcoin Slang track Robbie P first released under the Gzutek moniker — a parody of Big L’s Street Slang that swaps street survival lingo for Bitcoin culture. The remix remade the full production and dropped on Bitcoin Pizza Day 2021 as one of Robbie P’s first singles after returning from the Gzutek name.
